rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that something pulls A's attention away.

example.english: Your phone keeps ringing and can distract me.
example.traditional: 你部電話成日響，搞到我分心。
example.jyutping: nei5 bou6 din6 waa2 seng4 jat6 hoeng2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 fan1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when something or someone drives A crazy or insane.

example.english: If you keep making noise, you’ll distract me so much I’ll go crazy.
example.traditional: 你再嘈落去，搞到我發癲喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 cou4 lok6 heoi3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 faat3 din1 laa3
